messages.content: Hi, it's your Northline Care weekly check-in. How have your blood pressure numbers been this week? Any new symptoms or questions about your medications?

My BP was 168/104 yesterday morning. I already put it in the app and asked for a nurse to call me back. That was 30 hours ago and I haven't heard a single word. How long is this actually going to take?

I've logged that reading. I just checked the nurse queue — median callback time right now is 31 hours. You're nearly at that window. I know waiting this long when your numbers are elevated is stressful, and I'm sorry. I can't give clinical guidance myself, so a nurse really is the right next step here.
Median — so I could still wait even longer? That's not right. While I'm waiting can you at least send in a refill on my lisinopril? I'm running low.

Refills aren't something I'm able to handle — that has to come from your nurse or provider directly. I know that's not what you want to hear on top of everything else. Your escalation is already flagged in the queue, so I didn't send a duplicate. I've set your next weekly check-in for seven days out. Is there anything else I can log for you today?
No. Just make sure they know I've been sitting here waiting for over a day.

theme: asks how long a nurse will take to call back, frustrated after 30 hours
